test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following festivals is NOT associated with Sikkim?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lohri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Lohri**

 
 
• **​Lohri **is a festival that is not associated with **Sikkim**.
 
• Popular **Lohri **celebrations take place mostly in Northern India during the winter.
 
• The **Lohri **celebration has various meanings and tales, many of which relate it to the Punjab region. Many people think that the festival signifies the end of the winter solstice.
 
• People in the northern part of the **Indian **subcontinent celebrate **Lohri** to welcome the end of winter and the arrival of longer days and the sun in the northern hemisphere.
 
• According to the lunisolar **Punjabi calendar**, it is marked the night before Maghi and usually invariably falls on **January 13**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Losar**

 
 
• **Tibetan Buddhism** celebrates Losar, also referred to as the **Tibetan New Year**.
 
• Depending on local tradition, the event is observed on a variety of dates throughout **Tibet**, **Bhutan**, **Nepal**, **India**, and **Pakistan**.
 
 
 
• **Sakewa**
 
 
• For the **Kirat Khambu Rai** group in **Sikkim**, **Sakewa** is one of the most important cultural and religious celebrations.
 
• Community dances and other ceremonies are performed after the** Bhumi Puja**, which is observed as a tribute to **Mother Earth**.
 
 
 
• **Yenya**
 
 
• The largest event for the **Sikkim**-based Nepalese** "NEWAR" **population is** Indra Jatra**, also known as **"Yenya,"** and it is widely observed.
